title: A3 — High-performing networks
bodyMarkdown:
## High-performing networks

Exam task **3.4**. This lesson maps each knowledge and skill bullet from the supplied SAA-C03 guide.

### Knowledge

#### SAA-3.4-K01
Edge networking services with appropriate use cases (for example, Amazon CloudFront, AWS Global Accelerator)

**Tradeoffs:** Choose the simplest control that meets the requirement. Prefer managed services when operational overhead dominates. Use this lesson's citation link at the bottom before you lab. In a single-account lab, practice the smallest related resource then tear it down the same day. Multi-account or hybrid items may be design-only.

#### SAA-3.4-K02
How to design network architecture (for example, subnet tiers, routing, IP addressing)

**Tradeoffs:** Choose the simplest control that meets the requirement. Prefer managed services when operational overhead dominates. Use this lesson's citation link at the bottom before you lab. In a single-account lab, practice the smallest related resource then tear it down the same day. Multi-account or hybrid items may be design-only.
